answer: One work slot per identity: lock a 60-credit deposit and claim a terrace plot fed by an inlet. Each epoch the holder works the terrace and files a plume reading from its kiln and an inlet gauge reading, checked on the public table. A rented terrace cannot serve two slots, so the rented-terrace ring fails, and a missed reading burns the deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 78,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its slot.
